entries.name: Pre-sales engineering
entries.definition: Supporting the sales process by learning a customer's needs, demonstrating the product and designing a technical solution before the sale.

entries.name: Predictive analytics software
entries.definition: Software that applies statistical and machine-learning models to existing data to forecast future outcomes.

entries.name: Predictive modelling
entries.definition: Building statistical or machine-learning models that use known data to predict future or unknown outcomes.

entries.name: Presentation design
entries.definition: Designing slides and other visual presentation materials so that ideas are clear and engaging.

entries.name: Presentation software
entries.definition: Software for building and showing slide-based presentations, such as PowerPoint, Keynote and Google Slides.

entries.name: PrestoDB
entries.definition: The open-source distributed SQL query engine first developed at Facebook, now hosted by the Linux Foundation as Presto.

entries.name: Preventive dental care
entries.definition: Helping patients avoid tooth and gum disease through examinations, cleanings, fluoride, sealants and oral-hygiene teaching.

entries.name: Prezi
entries.definition: A cloud-based presentation tool that lays content out on a large zoomable canvas instead of separate slides.

entries.name: Price negotiation
entries.definition: Negotiating the price of goods or services with customers or suppliers.

entries.name: Price-to-book ratio
entries.definition: A valuation ratio that divides a company's share price by its book value per share, which is its assets minus its liabilities divided by its shares.

entries.name: PrimeRx
entries.definition: Pharmacy management software used to handle prescriptions, billing and inventory in a pharmacy.

entries.name: PRINCE2
entries.definition: A process-based method for managing projects in defined stages, first developed for the UK government.

entries.name: Principles for Responsible Banking
entries.definition: A voluntary framework launched in 2019 by the UN Environment Programme Finance Initiative for banks to align their strategy and business with the UN Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement.

entries.name: Print design
entries.definition: Designing layouts and artwork for printed materials such as brochures, posters and packaging.

entries.name: Printed circuit board design
entries.definition: Laying out the components and copper connections of a printed circuit board from an electronic schematic.

entries.name: Prisoners' rights
entries.definition: The legal rights of people held in prisons and jails, such as protection from cruel treatment and access to the courts.

entries.name: Privacy impact assessment
entries.definition: A structured process for finding and reducing the privacy risks of a project, system or policy that handles personal information.

entries.name: Private banking
entries.definition: Banking, lending and investment services tailored to wealthy individuals and families.

entries.name: Privileged access management
entries.definition: Controlling, securing and monitoring accounts with elevated permissions, such as administrator and root accounts.

entries.name: Problem solving
entries.definition: Working out what is causing a problem and finding and carrying out a way to resolve it.

entries.name: Process hazard analysis
entries.definition: A structured review of an industrial or chemical process to identify its hazards and judge whether its safeguards are adequate.

entries.name: Process improvement
entries.definition: Finding and putting in place changes that make a work process faster, cheaper, safer or more reliable.

entries.name: Process management
entries.definition: Planning, monitoring and improving how the steps of a business or manufacturing process are carried out.

entries.name: Process management (operating systems)
entries.definition: The part of an operating system that creates, schedules, switches between and ends the running programs on a computer.

entries.name: Process piping
entries.definition: Designing, fabricating, installing or inspecting piping that carries fluids in industrial plants such as refineries and chemical works.

entries.name: Process state
entries.definition: The condition of an operating-system process at a given moment, such as new, ready, running, waiting or terminated.

entries.name: Processing.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript port of the Processing visual programming language that runs Processing sketches in web browsers.

entries.name: Procore
entries.definition: Cloud-based construction management software for running projects, drawings, documents, budgets and field work in one place.

entries.name: Product analysis
entries.definition: Examining a product's features, quality, performance or market fit to judge how well it meets needs.

entries.name: Product analytics
entries.definition: Analysing how people use a digital product, such as which features they use and where they drop out, to guide product decisions.

entries.name: Product benchmarking
entries.definition: Comparing a product's features, price or performance with competing products to see where it stands and how to improve it.

entries.name: Product catalogue management
entries.definition: Creating, organising and keeping up to date the descriptions, prices and images of the products a business sells.

entries.name: Product leadership
entries.definition: Guiding a product's vision, strategy and development and leading the people responsible for it.

entries.name: Product quality assurance
entries.definition: Planning and carrying out checks across design, production and testing so that a product meets its quality requirements.

entries.name: Product requirements documentation
entries.definition: Writing product requirements documents that set out what a product should do, for whom and why, so design and engineering can build it.

entries.name: Product strategy
entries.definition: Deciding what a product should achieve, for whom, and how it will succeed in its market over time.

entries.name: Production support
entries.definition: Monitoring and troubleshooting a live system to resolve problems that affect users.

entries.name: Productivity management
entries.definition: Monitoring and improving how efficiently people or processes turn effort into output.

entries.name: Professional negligence in English law
entries.definition: The area of English law about claims against professionals, such as solicitors and surveyors, who fail to meet the standard of care expected of them.

entries.name: Professionalism
entries.definition: Behaving in line with the standards of conduct, reliability and courtesy expected in a workplace.
